odia: କେତେବେଳେ ଜୋଡ଼ା ମାଇପରେ ଘର କେତେବେଳେ ଚୂଲୀ ଫୁଙ୍କି ଫୁଙ୍କି ମର
title: A household’s changing circumstances
literal_meaning: At times, a home with two wives; at times, blow and blow at the hearth until you die.
explanation: The repeated “at times” turns a household image into an exhausting cooking complaint. The source gives no cause for the change. Our critical reading notices that the contrast relies on an expectation of women’s kitchen labour; describing that expectation does not make cooking their obligation.
meaning_odia: ବାରମ୍ବାର ଆସୁଥିବା “କେତେବେଳେ” ଘରର ଚିତ୍ରକୁ ରାନ୍ଧି ରାନ୍ଧି ହାଲିଆ ହେବାର ଅଭିଯୋଗ ସହ ଯୋଡ଼େ। ଏହି ବଦଳର କାରଣ ଉତ୍ସ କହେନାହିଁ। ଆମ ସମାଲୋଚନାମୂଳକ ପାଠରେ ଏଠି ନାରୀଙ୍କ ରୋଷେଇ ଶ୍ରମ ଉପରେ ଆଶା ରଖାଯାଇଛି; ସେହି ଆଶାକୁ ବୁଝିବା ଅର୍ଥ ରୋଷେଇ କେବଳ ତାଙ୍କ ଦାୟିତ୍ୱ ବୋଲି ମାନିବା ନୁହେଁ।
english_summary: Our critical reading distinguishes a household complaint from an obligation imposed on women.
odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ଘରର ଅଭିଯୋଗକୁ ନାରୀଙ୍କ ଉପରେ ଥୋପାଯାଇଥିବା ଦାୟିତ୍ୱଠାରୁ ଅଲଗା କରେ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: ପାଠଚକ୍ରରେ ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ପଢ଼ି ସମସ୍ତେ ରୋଷେଇ କାମ କିଏ କରେ ବୋଲି ଆଲୋଚନା କଲେ। ନିଜ ସଭାର ଭୋଜନ ପାଇଁ ସେମାନେ କାମ ବାଣ୍ଟିନେଲେ। / Readers discuss the complaint and share the work of preparing their meeting’s meal. This response is invented, not the saying’s traditional moral.
cultural_context: The quotation follows the figurative cooking sense. Its death wording is rhetorical here, not an established death event; no marriage history or reason for absence is supplied.
